rationale.usefulness: Detailed paid-access requirements, model rates, caching, reasoning defaults, image transport rules and web-search warnings make the hosted coding and 3D pilots practically useful. Concrete app acceptance tests and editable Blender/CAD workflows are clearly proposals rather than observed production outcomes.
rationale.impact: A long-context multimodal coding model integrated into several hosted products and 3D workflows could be consequential for agent-based building. Significance remains bounded by heterogeneous vendor evaluations, untested artifact delivery and the pending weight release.
rationale.novelty: The reported 3D construction focus, product integration and Highspeed variant provide meaningful differentiation. No comparable artifact test or consistent independent benchmark establishes an exceptional new capability; long context and tool-directed coding alone are not novel.
rationale.maturity: The API is documented sufficiently to plan a pilot, but placeholder benchmark text, differing internal accuracy accounts, production web-search warnings and absent execution verification are material readiness limits. A usable hosted evaluation is supported, broad autonomous reliability is not.
rationale.openness: Public API documentation and compatibility formats offer some inspectability and migration possibilities. As of the inspection date, weights are only promised for November 4, and their license and viable self-hosting are unknown, so future openness receives no present credit.

concerns: Unknown primary publication date correctly stays null; October discovery and a promised November weight release must not become a fabricated exact launch or availability date.
Provider performance comparisons use different harnesses, subsets and external reports. The report correctly avoids a numerical quality ranking.

Minor citation hardening opportunity: the body general-quickstart link uses /docs/overview, whereas the inspected source record resolves to /docs/get-your-api-key; use the saved canonical destination on a future substantive revision.
